labels.name: indonesia_next_working_day

labels.name: indonesia_holidays

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: indonesia_headlines_preview, indonesia_new_since, indonesia_search_preview, web_read · Private data: indonesia_series_preview, indonesia_series, web_read, indonesia_license_newsroom, indonesia_license_pilot, indonesia_license_growth, indonesia_license_enterprise · Public sink: indonesia_headlines, indonesia_search, indonesia_license_newsroom, indonesia_license_pilot, indonesia_license_growth, indonesia_license_enterprise · Destructive: indonesia_series_preview, indonesia_series, web_read, indonesia_license_growth, indonesia_license_enterprise.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: indonesia_headlines_preview, indonesia_new_since, indonesia_search_preview, web_read · Private data: indonesia_series_preview, indonesia_series, web_read, indonesia_license_newsroom, indonesia_license_pilot, indonesia_license_growth, indonesia_license_enterprise · Public sink: indonesia_headlines, indonesia_search, indonesia_license_newsroom, indonesia_license_pilot, indonesia_license_growth, indonesia_license_enterprise · Destructive: indonesia_series_preview, indonesia_series, web_read, indonesia_license_growth, indonesia_license_enterprise

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
